name: Spaces
title: Spaces.csv
description: What a space can hold. One row per space per visit type. The game, the editor, the classroom tools and the safety checks all read this file, so a new setting is declared once, here. Keys starting x- are this project's own hints (who may edit a field, which editor group it belongs in, what a teacher-added space gets).

x-notes.x-role: identity | content | effects | routing | behaviour | labels | layout
x-notes.x-editable-by: admin | teacher | none (none = edited somewhere else)
x-notes.x-placed: true when the hand-built editor form already shows this field; every other field appears under More settings
x-notes.x-authored: what a teacher-added space gets: {value} a fixed value, {copy: neighbour} the space it is spliced after, {copy: displayName} the teacher's chosen name. Absent = blank.
x-notes.x-enum-ignore-case: Yes, YES and yes all count as the same value
